title: Bounded receive slice 6: E2 service integration and real Windows proof
outcome: Bounded receive slice 6: E2 service integration and real Windows proof
acceptance: E2 automatic fetch consumes only a validated quarantine Ready handle; it never mutates the selected repository or writes an ImportReceipt from the receive primitive

A real Windows run over admitted OpenSSH demonstrates an in-budget receive and bounded refusals for oversized history, oversized pack and exhausted disk budget, with the filesystem flush/publication ordering the protocol relies on
The D1 fail-first matrix plus the D2 additions all pass in the full gate
